auth.label: Personal Access Token
auth.description: Jibble personal access token sent as a Bearer token. Generate one under Organization Settings > API Keys: https://www.jibble.io/help/using-jibbles-api-for-your-custom-needs.

actions.name: create_location
actions.description: Create a work location in Jibble.

name.description: The display name of the Jibble location.

address.description: The postal address of the Jibble location.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the Jibble location.

units.description: The Jibble distance unit used for the geofence radius.

geoFence.description: The geofence surrounding a Jibble location.

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of a Jibble location.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for creating a Jibble location.

location.description: The Jibble location returned by the API.

actions.name: delete_location
actions.description: Permanently delete a Jibble work location.

locationId.description: The Jibble location identifier to delete.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for deleting a Jibble location.

actions.name: get_organizations
actions.description: List the Jibble organizations accessible to the personal access token.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Jibble organizations.

anyOf.description: The total matching record count when Jibble returned it.

count.description: The total matching record count when Jibble returned it.

anyOf.description: The URL for the next OData page when Jibble returned one.

nextLink.description: The URL for the next OData page when Jibble returned one.

outputSchema.description: A normalized Jibble OData collection response.

actions.name: list_locations
actions.description: List Jibble work locations with optional OData filtering and pagination.

select.description: The comma-separated Jibble fields to return through the OData $select option.

filter.description: The OData $filter expression used to limit returned Jibble records.

expand.description: The OData $expand expression used to include related Jibble records.

orderBy.description: The OData $orderby expression used to sort returned Jibble records.

skip.description: The number of matching Jibble records to skip.

top.description: The maximum number of Jibble records to return.

count.description: Whether Jibble should include the total matching record count.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Jibble locations.
